findings.body: The added checks now cover unknown props for FinancialTotal, FinancialComparison, and ClarificationCard, but every MonthlyTrend fixture is valid and no case adds an unknown prop. The suite would still pass if MonthlyTrend.props stopped being strict, leaving one advertised UI contract unprotected. Add an unknown-prop rejection case for MonthlyTrend.
findings.title: Not done: strict output/UI props

findings.body: sameSelection compares serialized arrays, although plantIds are semantically a set elsewhere in financialQueryResultSchema. A required multi-Plant answer whose confirmed scope contains ["DUB", "CHIR"] rejects an otherwise valid included result containing ["CHIR", "DUB"]. Measure/filter set order has the same problem. Compare normalized selections or require canonical ordering in the selection schema.
findings.title: Treat reordered Plant sets as the same confirmed scope

findings.body: This branch defines only the clarification presentation shape; it does not implement pending-request continuation, scope retention, capacity/expiry, revocation checks, cancellation, or restart outcomes required by done-when item 3. The approved task table assigns those behaviors and their end-to-end proofs to MEMORY, GRAPH, API, STREAM, CLIENT, and REGRESSION.
findings.title: Later: MEMORY/GRAPH/API/STREAM/CLIENT/REGRESSION must prove clarification lifecycle

findings.body: The ready/failed detail union is only the presentation contract. Scope deduplication, preparation deadlines, source/mapping pins, stable full traversal, authorization rechecks, and browser identity/total comparisons required by done-when item 4 depend on the assigned DRILL, PAGES, ANSWER, DETAIL, and BROWSER tasks.
findings.title: Later: DRILL/PAGES/ANSWER/DETAIL/BROWSER must implement prepared Actual paging

findings.body: Pinning the provider and model ID in capabilities does not establish direct ChatAnthropic execution, trusted instruction ordering, static-prefix caching, payload exclusions, vendor errors, or gated live runs required by done-when item 6. Those implementations and proofs are assigned to MODEL, GRAPH, ANSWER, and LIVE.
findings.title: Later: MODEL/GRAPH/ANSWER/LIVE must prove Claude and static-cache boundaries
